source_semantics.table: KDreams 直近4ヶ月の成績 PRE table

candidate_scalar_contract.name: OBJECTIVE_TACTICAL_PROFILE_SCALAR_V1
candidate_scalar_contract.formula: ((nige + makuri) - (sashi + mark)) / (nige + makuri + sashi + mark) when denominator > 0; exactly 0 when all four explicitly observed PRE counts are 0
candidate_scalar_contract.interpretation: positive=self-propelled/initiative-oriented observed tactical mix; negative=finish/follow-oriented observed tactical mix; zero=balanced mix or explicitly observed zero counts
candidate_scalar_contract.zero_denominator_semantics: NOT_UNKNOWN_IF_ALL_FOUR_SOURCE_COUNTS_ARE_EXPLICITLY_ZERO; encode neutral 0 by prespec rather than posthoc repair

why_this_is_not_the_prior_style_candidat: The prior style-role scalar used the coarse categorical style field only. This source-audited scalar uses four objective PRE rolling tactical-count fields already emitted by the parser and does not use human lineup forecasts.
selection_independence: The scalar definition is fixed from source semantics and the pre-existing tactical-feature direction; it is not chosen from the signs of 2026-07-05 venue slices.
